headline: Rules and Orders of the City Council and City Council Standing Committees.
summary: The agenda covers the rules and orders that govern the council. It also covers the rules for its standing committees.
items: #363 Rules and Orders of the City Council
location: City Council Chambers, 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor

City of Salem, Massachusetts 
Office of the City Clerk

MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
 
The Salem City Council Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Monday 
November 9, 2026, at 6:00 PM for the purpose of discussing Rules and Orders of the 
Salem City Council and City Council Standing Committees.  This meeting will be held in 
the City Council Chambers. 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor.
